source: Shaped from Sentry's OpenAPI spec (getsentry/sentry-api-schema openapi-derefed.json at b1eac6b, 2026-10-16, read 2026-10-17), operationId listOrganizationEvents (dataset=logs; the spec's dataset enum is errors, logs, profile_functions, spans, tracemetrics, uptime_results, so there is no ourlogs): the 200 body is shaped from the documented response schema ({data, meta} with meta.fields and meta.units) after the spec's QueryEvents example. Query keys are in url.Values.Encode order; repeated field values keep their order. Not live-proven: no Sentry account recorded this.
